description:
You are a freelance 3D artist assembling a client showreel in Blender's Video Sequence Editor.

Three pre-rendered video clips are located in '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/footage/':
- clip_A.mp4 (blue-tinted exterior shot)
- clip_B.mp4 (amber-tinted detail shot)
- clip_C.mp4 (green-tinted interior shot)

Blender is open in the Video Editing workspace. Complete the following:

1. Import all three clips (clip_A.mp4, clip_B.mp4, clip_C.mp4) into the Video Sequence Editor as Movie strips.
2. Arrange them sequentially on the timeline: clip A first, then clip B, then clip C.
3. Add cross-dissolve (or gamma cross) transition effects between adjacent clips (at least one transition).
4. Add a Text strip containing the title 'BMW Showcase Reel' (visible somewhere in the edit).
5. Set the scene frame range to cover the full assembled sequence.
6. Configure render output as FFmpeg video (H.264/MPEG-4) with output path: '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/final_edit.mp4'
7. Render the full animation to produce the output video.
8. Save the project file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/video_edit.blend'

The source clips are 960x540 at 24fps. Use matching resolution for the output.
